نستوطأ (form X)
# نُسْتَوْطَأُ (nustawṭaʔu) /nus.taw.tˤa.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# نُسْتَوْطَأَ (nustawṭaʔa) /nus.taw.tˤa.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# نُسْتَوْطَأْ (nustawṭaʔ) /nus.taw.tˤaʔ/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
